title: The rest of the band and Club Forest
summary: Lewis cannot name the rhythm section but recalls the job at Club Forest, played while he was still with the Eureka band.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Can you remember who else was in that band? Can you remember who was in the rhythm section?

No. on the water from Empire, Louisiana. It's down there about 10 miles before you get to Puyres. I'm not quite there. I was doing a little bit of a storm was down there. The first tribute major to play at the Club Forest out there up South Cleveland was there. Kenner. He was playing there when B.B.G. died.
Club what was it? The Club what?

Forest. Club Forest. That's where Loi was playing. The Club was a fall band. This band wasn't my regular band. I don't know. I was still playing with my the party. I was in the Eureka band. Some of the bands had to die.
